capabilities: show a configurable clock with time, date and seconds
display current weather and an optional 5-day forecast from Open-Meteo
view events from up to 5 .ics calendar feeds with recurring-event support
run a countdown timer with presets, pause/resume and end-of-time alerts
reorder, hide and theme dashboard items to fit sidebar or full-width layouts
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes or journaling tool; despite the name, it only displays a clock, weather, calendar feeds and a timer.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README details network use (only Open-Meteo and user-added calendar URLs, no telemetry) and warns that calendar .ics URLs are stored in data.json and could leak if the vault is shared or published.
problem: Obsidian has no at-a-glance view combining the time, weather and calendar events, so users must leave the app or open separate tools for them.

relations.evidence: Weather: current temperature, conditions and today's high/low, plus an optional 5-day forecast, from Open-Meteo
read-only view of up to 5 .ics feeds (Google Calendar, iCloud, Outlook, Nextcloud, …)

summary: Dashboard widget that shows a clock, Open-Meteo weather, .ics calendar feeds and a countdown timer in a sidebar, tab or pop-out.
